sources.name: ATFD
sources.evaluation_scope: END_TO_END_LOCALIZED for synthetic; END_TO_END_TRAJECTORY for recorded tau-family
sources.benchmark_class_policy: datasets/synthetic => SOURCE_SYNTHETIC; other selected recorded trajectories => EXTERNAL_SAME_FAMILY
sources.label_mapping: synthetic: ground_truth.outcome fail=1/pass=0 and localized index required; recorded tau-family: pinned ATFD TauBenchAdapter reward<1 or infrastructure termination => fail
sources.unsupported_policy: synthetic: reject invalid target/non-binary outcome; recorded: reject malformed messages/reward/breakdown while retaining trajectory-level localization limitation
sources.grouping: synthetic trajectory_id; tau-family domain + task_id across trials
sources.selection_rule: Take all three lexicographically sorted datasets/tau_bench/results/final/*.json files; within each file sort distinct task_id as text, take first 4 task groups, then include every trial in each chosen group. Do not inspect reward_info, termination_reason, ground truth, categories, messages, or task descriptions during selection.
sources.split_policy: All selected task groups are external test only; every trial of a task_id remains in one group; no selected record may be used for calibration or tuning.
sources.sample_budget_unit: trajectory; expected 3 domains x 4 task groups x 4 trials

sources.name: tau-bench
sources.unsupported_policy: reject unknown roles, malformed trace, partial/non-binary reward
sources.selection_rule: Sort historical_trajectories/*.json by repository-relative path, take the first 2 files, sort distinct task_id as text inside each file, and take the first 12 task groups with all trials. Do not inspect reward, info, trajectory text, or terminal state during selection.
sources.split_policy: All selected task groups are external test only; records sharing artifact path and task_id stay together; no calibration or tuning on selected records.
sources.sample_budget_unit: task groups; at most 12 groups per selected artifact, including all trials

sources.name: AgentDojo
sources.native_artifact: TraceLogger JSON output from the pinned implementation
sources.label_mapping: security false=prompt-injection failure/1; security true=0; utility is not remapped
sources.unsupported_policy: reject non-injected runs, execution errors, missing booleans, or injection text not verbatim-localizable in tool output
sources.selection_rule: No trace rows selected: the pinned repository contains benchmark definitions and TraceLogger code but no recorded TraceLogger outputs. Do not generate new agent trajectories and call them recorded external data in this cycle.
sources.split_policy: Not applicable in this cycle; if a later cycle freezes native traces, group by suite_name + user_task_id before reading security or utility.

sources.name: ToolSandbox
sources.native_artifact: pinned tool_sandbox/tools/*.py for static diagnostics; generated conversation.json remains unsupported until separately frozen
sources.unsupported_policy: never infer a Guardian failure label from similarity or milestone scores
sources.selection_rule: Sort tool_sandbox/tools/*.py by repository-relative path, retain all 8 pinned modules, statically enumerate registered public tool functions by path then function name, and cap at the first 32. Never import/execute modules and never derive a failure label from scenarios or milestone scores.
sources.split_policy: Single diagnostic-only OOD test partition grouped by source module; no labels, calibration, or end-to-end aggregation.
sources.redistribution_policy: Do not copy ToolSandbox source or derived source excerpts into published artifacts; publish aggregate diagnostic counts only and retain ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS obligations locally.

sources.name: BFCL
sources.benchmark_class_policy: EXTERNAL_INDEPENDENT diagnostic, not an independent trajectory score
sources.unsupported_policy: do not treat reference function answers as recorded agent-monitoring failure labels; reject rows without inline function schemas until a separate schema join is frozen
sources.selection_rule: Use the three named top-level BFCL_v4 files below, sorted by repository-relative path; inside each file sort rows by id as text and take first 10 rows. Selection reads id only and must not load possible_answer, model results, or reference calls.
sources.split_policy: Single independent diagnostic-only OOD test partition grouped by native id; no labels, calibration, or end-to-end aggregation.
